text:
Alice M.: quick flag — docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 is failing CI on the SDK snippet tests for streaming + pagination. Anyone free to triage?
Ben K.: saw the failure in the logs, looks like ts snippet uses old paginate API (cursor vs async iterator) and the linter is unhappy about a stray backtick.
Carol S.: I can take python snippets. Which branch do we need to fix? main or v1.1-backport?
Alice M.: ideally both — main for the live site and v1.1 for the pinned release notes. We should backport minimal changes (no new features).
Dave R.: assigning TS -> I’ll update the snippet to use async iterator and add a quick test. Any guidance on how strict the examples should be vs. the SDK code?
Ben K.: keep examples concise but runnable. For streaming pagination show both the sync cursor and async iterator variants, but mark the cursor one as deprecated in a note.
Emma (docs-bot): FYI automated link-checker found one broken embed: docs/reference/streams.md#pagination (404) — that might be related.
Carol S.: python fix: replace the generator example with a streaming iterator, small snippet: ```python
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient()
async for chunk in client.chat_stream("Hello"):
    print(chunk.text)
```
Carol S.: will also add a note about retry param: `retries=3` default and show `retry_config = {"max_attempts": 5, "backoff": 0.5}`
Alice M.: @Dave R. please also adjust the TS snippet to include the `retry` option and mention backoff. Ben, can you confirm test harness expectations?
Ben K.: test harness expects examples to run in <3s in CI sandbox. For streaming tests we mock the socket; I’ll update mocks to accept the new iterator shape.
Dave R.: TS patch in progress, pushing branch docs/ts-stream-fix-180045. snippet: ```ts
import { Redwood } from "@redwood/inference"
const client = new Redwood()
for await (const chunk of client.chat.stream("hi")) {
  console.log(chunk.text)
}
```
Dave R.: also added a small change to the code fence language (ts -> typescript) to appease the markdown linter. :slightly_smiling_face:
ci-bot: build #2045 failed — unit-tests/snippets (timeout)
Ben K.: timeout was flaky — increasing test timeout from 2s -> 8s in the harness. I'll open a tiny PR against the tests repo.
Alice M.: Plan: 1) Dave pushes TS patch to PR 432, 2) Carol pushes python patch to same PR, 3) Ben updates test harness and mock. Once CI green, we backport to v1.1 branch and cut a docs patch release.
Carol S.: pushing python commit now, small formatting fix + retry note.
Dave R.: pushed TS commit 1800456901 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432/files — added tests + snippet update.
Ben K.: tests patched in tests/integration#178, linking to docs PR for the CI bump.
Emma (docs-bot): reminder: update the changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md with a short line "Fix streaming + pagination examples; clarify retries"
Alice M.: after CI is green, @Emma can you schedule a site rebuild?
Emma (docs-bot): sure — will trigger deploy once PR is merged.
Ben K.: CI just turned green on the PR build. :tada:
Dave R.: awesome, I'll open the backport PR to v1.1 with the same commits (no changes).
Carol S.: backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/439 — also included a tiny fix to the go snippet formatting (tab vs spaces).
Alice M.: thanks all. Follow-up items: 1) audit other streaming pages for cursor mentions, 2) add a short migration note in /migration/1.x-to-2.0.md, 3) monitor for any user questions after deploy.
Ben K.: noted — I'll add a ticket to the docs board. :thumbsup:
Emma (docs-bot): deploy scheduled after merge, will post status here.
ci-bot: deploy queued -> waiting on merge
Alice M.: closing loop here, great cross-team response. If anything else pops up, @channel.
